breaking.change: Removed with UiScope.unmount and the .svelte documents they mounted: the UI is TSX components on the native renderer, and a scope only keeps the game's stores (writable, readable, derived, collection, get).
breaking.fix: Mount the screen's TSX component instead: `const unmount = mount(world, () => <PauseScreen … />, {}, { layer: "menu" })` from `@origingame/engine/ui` (the built-in screens are in `@origingame/engine/ui/components`), and call `unmount()` where you called scope.unmount. Read a store in the component with `useStore(store)()`.
